mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or if the correlation between UNRATE rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or if the correlation between RSAFS increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%, or if the correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% year-over-year, the real interest rate is negative, signaling a loose monetary policy that boosts equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, or if the correlation between this condition and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, it signals a weakening demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY < -10% and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST YoY < -10% and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or if the correlation between this condition and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 3%, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS > 3% and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
